runtime_findings.grant_timing: once on effective_from, if policy ID not previously received
runtime_findings.decile_grants_priority: nonempty decile_grants is evaluated before income_grants; a new household-income profile cannot override this branch
runtime_findings.legacy_persona_income: generated income tier is not verified income
runtime_findings.new_profile_preparation: explicit opt-in same profile for Dawn and eligibility; not deployed; preserves household income definition and requires documented band-to-tier mapping

official_rules.entitlement_unit: individual; minors generally apply and receive through resident-register head
official_rules.nationality: nationals; foreigner exceptions require specific residence/register and health-insurance or medical-aid conditions
official_rules.minor_rule_source_note: September official briefing explicitly says same application rule as first round; not evidence minors have no entitlement

implemented_policy.actual_status_substitution: consumption decile 1 substitutes basic welfare status, decile 2 substitutes nearpoor/single-parent status, deciles 3-10 general category

why_not: low consumption is not legal welfare-recipient status
household income band does not establish assets, recognized income, recipient certification or household rules used by welfare programs
income profile does not replace decile_grants priority
citizenship, reference residence, adult/head application and actual take-up are separate conditions
needed_fields: exact birth date and minor applicant/head relation
policy_household_id and household_head_agent_id for minor routing
policies.interpretation: existing pilot is a consumption-decile grant scenario, not an individually verified reconstruction of first-round recipients

official_rules.health_premium_reference: 2025-06 assessed household aggregate; thresholds depend on insurance type, household size and multi-earner treatment
official_rules.high_asset_exclusion: household 2024 property-tax base > 1.2 billion won or 2024 financial income > 20 million won

needed_fields: policy household membership and spouse/child health dependent links across addresses
June 2025 actual assessed health premium and job/regional/mixed insurance class
number of income earners and applicable household-size adjustment
2024 household property-tax base and financial income
policies.warning: do not add second-round top-decile or health-premium rules to the first-round July policy

official_rules.selection_scope: final scheme expanded to all national households, unlike preliminary bottom-70-percent proposal
official_rules.household_definition: resident-register household with health-insurance dependent concept
official_rules.card_application: head-of-household card; online applications from May 11; actual credit generally around two days after application
official_rules.cash_payment: eligible vulnerable households received automatic cash from May 4
official_rules.local_adjustment: some prior local-government payments may alter amount

implemented_policy.amount_conversion_status: policy-file claimed average conversion, not an entitlement rule or empirically linked household assignment
implemented_policy.byte_difference: local Windows CRLF vs preserved LF; 66 CRLF pairs; LF-normalized bytes match preserved SHA exactly

needed_fields: policy household ID and members including minor dependents
vulnerable automatic-cash eligibility or chosen application/payment path
unverified_details: 2020 foreign-national, overseas-stay and household-reference-date edge-case rules were not fully verified in this time-limited audit; do not assume 2025 rules apply
policies.interpretation: individual 280000-won wallets replace household amount, recipient, timing and intra-household allocation; matching individual age/sex/dong/income margins does not restore these rights

recommended_gates: runtime_input_binding_gate: same frozen individual profile reaches Dawn and eligibility
policy_eligibility_gate: policy-version-specific verified or transparently imputed recipient fields plus documented assumptions
mechanism_gate: household/individual benefit unit, payment date, wallet routing and merchant eligibility are represented
effect_validation_gate: empirical estimand, paired run quality and uncertainty remain separate
allowed_future_assumptions: An explicitly declared conditional scenario may assume eligible nationals and complete application, but it must not be labelled empirically verified recipient matching. Missing nationality/welfare/household fields cannot silently become inferred eligibility from consumption decile or income tier.
prompt_leakage_boundary: actual policy benefit amounts, eligibility thresholds and dates are allowed rule inputs; measured MPC, expenditure effects, sector shares or desired answers stay evaluator-only.
